summary.text: Susan Estes is a Republican state representative from Kansas House District 87 who has served since January 2021 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
She has worked as a teacher, a market researcher and a business development specialist.

paragraphs.text: Susan Estes' career experience includes working as a teacher, a market researcher and a business development specialist.
She has volunteered with Kansas Honor Flight and American Legion Post 4.
Estes assumed office in the Kansas House on January 11, 2021, succeeding Renee Erickson, and no other candidate is listed for the seat in the November 2026 general election.
